rule_subject: 马来西亚 halal 法定定义与认证母法框架
content: Act 730 (Trade Descriptions Act 2011) ss.28–29 empower halal definition and certification orders. P.U.(A) 430/2011 defines when food/goods/services may be described as halal (para 3: not prohibited by Hukum Syarak / proper slaughter; not najis; not intoxicating; no unlawful human parts; not hazardous; equipment not contaminated; not mixed with non-halal). Commencement 1 January 2012. P.U.(A) 431/2011 designates JAKIM and State Islamic Religious Councils as competent authorities (independent AGC PDF URL not stably retrieved this batch — Act 730 index and cross-checked instrument number used; no fabricated link). Act 730 index: https://lom.agc.gov.my/act-detail.php?language=BI&type=original&act=730. rule_subject: P.U.(A) 430/2011 第3条：halal 法定定义要件
content: When food or goods are described as halal (or any expression indicating fitness for Muslim consumption/use), the expression means the food or goods: (a) neither is nor consists of/contains any part of an animal prohibited by Hukum Syarak or not slaughtered in accordance with Hukum Syarak; (b) does not contain anything impure (najis) according to Hukum Syarak; (c) does not intoxicate according to Hukum Syarak; (d) does not contain any part of a human being or its yield not allowed by Hukum Syarak; (e) is not poisonous or hazardous to health; (f) has not been prepared/processed/manufactured using instruments contaminated with impurity according to Hukum Syarak; and (g) has not in preparing/processing/storing been in contact with, mixed, or close proximity to food failing (a)/(b). Hukum Syarak defined by reference to Shafi‘i (and other mazhabs as approved). rule_subject: halal 技术标准与 JAKIM 认证程序基准
content: MS 1500:2019 (Halal Food—General Requirements) by Department of Standards Malaysia is the technical yardstick for ingredients, processing, packaging, labelling, storage, transport and retail. MPPHM (Malaysia Halal Certification Procedure Manual), issued by JAKIM pursuant to the certification order framework, sets application, audit, inspection and issuance procedures (Domestic 2020). Online portal: https://www.halal.gov.my; application: https://myehalal.halal.gov.my; standards catalogue: https://mysol.jsm.gov.my.
